meta.query: Plot enrollment against duration for completed Duchenne muscular dystrophy trials.

interpretation.summary: Plotting one point per trial for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (Status: Completed).

strategy.name: walk
strategy.reason: All 240 trials were read and grouped here.

interpretation.chart_rationale: Rule 1: two numbers per trial, so a scatter plot with one point per trial.

plan.interpretation: Plot enrollment against duration for completed Duchenne muscular dystrophy trials.

assumptions: Matched 'Duchenne muscular dystrophy' with the registry's condition search (conditions, titles, keywords and MeSH terms, with synonyms).
Enrollment counts, estimated and actual, are both used.
Duration runs from the start date to the completion date, a month counting as its first day.

citations.selection: trials naming the searched entity first, then most recently first-posted, then by NCT ID

trace.summary: Plot enrollment against duration for completed Duchenne muscular dystrophy trials.
